title: Distributed Solar Aggregation
desc: We aggregate kilowatt-scale residential and commercial rooftop solar producers into institutional-grade verified carbon offset batches.

title: Real-Time Telemetry & Verification
desc: Smart IoT telemetry gateways transmit meter readings every 15 minutes, ensuring tamper-proof audit trails and preventing greenwashing.

title: Transparent 4% Gateway Fee
desc: Cabo is strictly a clearing gateway. 96% of net carbon revenue goes directly to rooftop owners, while Cabo retains only a 4% clearing fee.

title: Automated Weekly Settlement
desc: Energy generation is verified weekly and converted into instant financial payouts credited directly into rooftop solar producers' bank accounts.

title: Corporate ESG Compliance
desc: Corporate buyers purchase verifiable Scope 2 and Scope 3 carbon credits with complete provenance, generation curves, and audit reports.

title: Grid Decarbonization
desc: By incentivizing decentralized renewable generation, Cabo accelerates national net-zero goals and strengthens localized distribution grids.
